description.default: Free · Projects, tasks, schedule & reminders in one workbench: every night the AI loads tomorrow's ammo — tasks, quotas, anchors; every day you just fire, no tracking — the plan IS the ledger. Feishu calendar sync (server-push reminders), gantt lanes, timeline, MCP tools.
description.zh_CN: 免费 · 把项目、任务、日程、提醒收进一个工作台：晚上 AI 备好明天的弹药——任务、配额、锚点；白天照着打，不用记录，计划即账本。飞书日历双向同步（服务端推送，思源关着也能到）、甘特图、当天时间线、MCP 工具族让 AI 替你操作一切。
